2034-5220-6277-6705-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-5220-6277-6705-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6634-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

2390-3966-6878.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-3966-6878.description:
Gain life.
Qala triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-5517-8190.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three creatures with different powers.
Loot has a +1/+1 counter on it.

826-1636-6243-8095.easyPrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-1636-6243-8095.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing another nontoken creature you control to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield as a white Angel.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

856-5631-5776-6495.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
856-5631-5776-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3755-3899-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
3755-3899-4871-5220.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2457-3499-4289-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2173-4496-5220-6273.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
When Accursed Centaur enters, it triggers, sacrificing itself.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

141-2438-7449.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
141-2438-7449.description:
Cast Stir the Grave by paying {4}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Stir the Grave.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stir the Grave
Resolve the Stir the Grave copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

856-2921-4321-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2921-4321-7396.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

891-5617-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4053-4336-6798-6989.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

147-5117-6798.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Undying Malice, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Undying Malice.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 5.

270-1987-4423-6918.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Hedron Archive by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Hedron Archive.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2034-3490-6872.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2104-2974-6689.easyPrerequisites: You control four or more artifacts.
2104-2974-6689.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Repository Skaab by paying {3}{U}.
When Repository Skaab enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing it to exploit itself. Its second ability then triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Golbez's second ability triggers, returning Repository Skaab from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

5078-5864-6055-6766.notablePrerequisites: Poison Dart Frog does not have summoning sickness.
5078-5864-6055-6766.description:
Activate Poison Dart Frog's first ability by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Repeat.

1526-3464-3657.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
1526-3464-3657.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Circle of Dreams Druid.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1526-3464-3657.notes: If you get infinite mana, you can repeat steps 2-5 infinitely to untap any other creature(s)

2034-2961-6553.easyPrerequisites: False Demise attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2034-2961-6553.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, False Demise triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Repeat.

804-997-2533-4681.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Sakashima the Impostor enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat.

1636-1648-5996.easyPrerequisites: Tarmogoyf Nest does not have summoning sickness.
1636-1648-5996.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
1636-1648-5996.description:
Activate Nissa of Shadowed Boughs's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
When the Tarmogoyf enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

1405-2923-5231.notablePrerequisites: An opponent's life total is higher than or equal to your life total.
1405-2923-5231.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning Scourge of the Throne from your graveyard to the battlefield, and giving it haste until end of turn.
Declare Scourge of the Throne as an attacker, attacking an opponent whose life total is higher than or equal to yours.
Scourge of the Throne's dethrone ability and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger, causing you to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Scourge of the Throne, adding {R}.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger from step 3, doing nothing.
Repeat each combat phase.

1479-3585-5478-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3585-5478-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Greensleeves trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

116-2569-3455.notablePrerequisites:
Vizier of Many Faces is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Vizier of Many Faces do not have summoning sickness.
116-2569-3455.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Vizier of Many Faces.
Activate Vizier of Many Faces by tapping it.
When Vizier of Many Faces becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Vizier of Many Faces's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

116-2569-3668.notablePrerequisites:
Flesh Duplicate is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Flesh Duplicate do not have summoning sickness.
116-2569-3668.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Flesh Duplicate.
Activate Flesh Duplicate by tapping it.
When Flesh Duplicate becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Flesh Duplicate's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

199-3946-4935.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

513-3542-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}.
513-3542-3821.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Peregrine Drake to your hand from the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Palinchron to your hand from the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
If you control a land that can tap to produce at least {2}, this combo nets infinite mana.

905-1875-2429.description:
Activate Jade Monolith by paying {1}, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
When the creature dies, Revel in Riches' first ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

803-1909-3181.notablePrerequisites:
Krosan Restorer does not have summoning sickness.
You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
You control a Forest.
"Elf" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1909-3181.description:
Activate Krosan Restorer's second ability by tapping it, untapping a Forest and two other lands you control.
Activate the Forest and at least one other land by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Repeat.

2719-4050-4783.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2719-4050-4783.notablePrerequisites: Sakashima of a Thousand Faces is one of your commanders.
2719-4050-4783.description:
Cast Sakashima either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{U} and commander tax, if applicable.
Choose to have Sakashima enter the battlefield as a copy of Hellkite Courser.
Sakashima enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sakashima, adding one mana of any color.
Choose to return Sakashima to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Sakashima trigger from step 3, putting Sakashima from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2719-2744-2808.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2719-2744-2808.description:
Cast Sakashima by paying {3}{U} and commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Enduring Scalelord.
Sakashima enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Enduring Scalelord and Sakashima triggers.
Resolve the Sakashima trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Enduring Scalelord triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 4.

2493-3047-4050.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying {B}, targeting Archaeomancer.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Archaeomancer, adding {B}.
Archaeomancer triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Feign Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

553-966.description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Unsubstantiate by paying its mana cost, returning Approach of the Second Sun to your hand.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying its mana cost, causing you to win the game.

1592-4702.description:
Activate Karrthus, putting a token copy of Karrthus onto the battlefield.
The token copy is put into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token copy's enter the battlefield ability triggers, untapping all dragons you control.
Repeat.

1978-2364-4241.description:
Animate Mana Vault using Karn.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mana Vault.
Repeat from step 2.

503-1012-2908-3676.description:
Cast Dream Stalker by paying {1}.
Kefnet's Monument and Tangleroot triggers.
Resolve the Kefnet's Monument trigger, tapping target creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Tangleroot trigger, adding {G}.
Dream Stalker enters the battlefield, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
